h3. Environment

* Production — Chrome 154 / Windows 10.

h3. Steps to reproduce

# Open {{/workorders?status=bogus}} (or the comma form, {{/workorders?status=approved,estimate}}).
# Read the list and the Status chip.
# Open the Status menu.
# Click Clear all filters.
# Open {{/workorders}} with no parameters.

h3. Expected result

The page ignores status values it doesn't recognize and shows the unfiltered list. At minimum, an active filter shows what it's filtering by.

h3. Actual result

"No work orders match these filters" with a Clear all filters button. The Status chip is highlighted as active with a clear (x) icon but shows no value, and no option is ticked in the menu, so you can't see what's filtering. Clear all filters recovers the list. Opening {{/workorders}} with no parameters restores the real saved filter, so nothing from the URL is saved.



*Evidence:*

[^invalid URL.webm]



h3. QA note

The app itself writes repeated parameters ({{status=approved&status=estimate}}). The comma form fails the same way as an unknown value. Tech View and Board View (new displays, not yet released) behave the same.
